own_settings.photo_too_big: That picture could not be used. Try another one.
own_settings.password_mismatch: Does not match the new one
own_settings.password_hint: This device stays signed in; your other devices are signed out.
own_settings.password_changed: Password changed, and your other devices were signed out.
own_settings.channels_subtitle: Link your own Telegram or WhatsApp so the agent's Core Hub tools act as you when you message its bot. A message from an account nobody linked gets none of them, and a group chat none either.
own_settings.channels_none: No messaging account is linked to you.
own_settings.channels_send_this: From the Telegram or WhatsApp account you want to link, send this to your agent's bot:
own_settings.channels_must_answer: The bot must already answer you (paired, or on its allowed list). It replies when the account is linked.
own_settings.channels_linked: Linked. Messages from that account now use Core Hub's tools as you.
own_settings.channels_unlink_body: Its next message gets none of Core Hub's tools. The agent still answers it.
own_settings.inbox_none_body: What happens in the hub appears here: a reply that finished, or an approval waiting for you.
own_settings.privacy_access_hint: Paired phones and integrations each hold a token that acts as you. Revoke one and it stops working at once; a paired device is unlinked.
own_settings.privacy_revoke_body: Anything using this token loses access at once. This cannot be undone.
own_settings.privacy_revoke_device_body: This device loses access at once and is unlinked; pairing it again gives it a new token.
own_settings.privacy_none: No app or device holds a token
own_settings.privacy_none_body: Only your own sign-ins can reach your account.
own_settings.privacy_browsers_note: Browsers you signed in to are not listed here. Changing your password under Account signs out every other device; it does not revoke the tokens above.
own_settings.privacy_redact_title: What reaches the model from messaging channels
